topRecommendations: Add a full Modern Endpoint Provisioning & Lifecycle module (the single biggest hireability gap, verified as zero coverage across all 32 lessons): Windows Autopilot + Enrollment Status Page, co-management with SCCM/MECM and workload sliders, Win32 app packaging (.intunewin) with detection rules, and Windows Update for Business update rings / patch-compliance reporting. These are headline must-haves in nearly every Modern Endpoint / Senior Desktop Support JD.

Fix and run-verify the three confirmed lab/capstone code bugs before any of this is used as portfolio material: ht2-l08:116 New-MgGroupMember must resolve to the Entra device directoryObject id, not $d.AzureAdDeviceId (critical); ht3-l08:119-120 KQL must project DeviceNetworkEvents.RemoteUrl/RemoteIP and join on DeviceId not DeviceName (major); ht2-l03:156 replace the PS7-only ternary with if/else or label PS7-only (major). All three contradict principles the course itself teaches.

Add cross-platform and cloud-endpoint coverage: macOS via Jamf+Intune, iOS/iPadOS/Android MDM and MAM/app-protection, Apple Business Manager enrollment, plus a Windows 365/Cloud PC and AVD primer. Pick at least the Apple+Android MDM/MAM piece even if AVD stays introductory.

Modernize identity/security currency: add Entra Cloud Sync and reframe AD FS as legacy in ht3-l05; add token protection and device-bound passkeys to ht3-l02 (tying to the ht3-l08 token-theft capstone); prefer v1.0 Graph endpoints in production examples (ht2-l04); replace the hardcoded Microsoft.Graph 2.0.0 pin in ht2-l07 with a placeholder/current build.

Realign certifications and add achievement-style labs: put MD-102 first in the ht4-l08 roadmap (MD-102 to MS-102 to SC-200 to AZ-104 to AZ-500 to AI-102), add a Power BI device-health/compliance reporting lesson, and attach a solution key/rubric plus quantified provisioning/app-deployment metrics to the labs.

Preserve the course's core strengths while fixing the above: the RCA mental models, safety-first automation defaults, and reasoning-style quizzes are the differentiators and must not be diluted during the rework.
